capabilities: Mount a real folder under any other folder in the file explorer
Mount a single note in several places at once
Mirror source create, rename and delete in the virtual tree
Open the native source context menu from a virtual entry
Follow a renamed or moved source folder automatically
disambiguation: Not a way to mount external drives or cloud storage; it only draws extra entries for folders and notes already in the vault.
extras: Depends on Obsidian's internal file-explorer DOM, so a major Obsidian update may need an adaptation; virtual paths are not linkable and do not appear in search, Quick Switcher or Graph. At the time of writing it was not yet listed in the community plugin browser, so install is manual or via BRAT.
problem: A folder or note can only appear at its real path in the file explorer, so showing it in a second place means moving, copying or duplicating it.

relations.evidence: Add ko-Ani/obsidian-virtual-mount as a beta plugin; updates can then be installed from inside Obsidian.

summary: View-layer plugin that shows a real folder or note as a virtual subfolder in the file explorer, without moving, copying or symlinking files.
